Adjust name space

The dotted guide is only in the editor; it is never exported. Use these controls to position the name in the blank space between the invitation lines.

Export & sharing

Important: browsers only allow an attachment to be handed to WhatsApp/email through the device share sheet when supported. WhatsApp's web link and mailto fallback cannot attach files automatically. If file sharing isn't supported, download the invitation and attach it manually.
